messages:
Nora (People Ops): Quick heads-up  cohort of 3 onboarding tomorrow. One edge-case: Zoe had a legal name change after marriage last month and her passport is under her maiden name. Vendor flagged name mismatch for the background check and I-9. Can we discuss options? :thinking:
Background-Vendor: Flag: identity docs uploaded show maiden surname on passport, SSN & bank docs show married name. Please provide a certified name-change document or signed affidavit. Processing paused until resolved.
Zoe (New Hire): I have the marriage certificate PDF and a receipt that my passport renewal is in-process. I can bring originals tomorrow. What's acceptable to complete I-9 on day 1?
HR-Bot: Official guidance: employer must examine acceptable documents from List A OR a combination of List B + List C. If legal name differs due to marriage, a certified marriage certificate is acceptable proof of name change. Link: https://www.uscis.gov/i-9/list-of-acceptable-documents
Nora (People Ops): Thanks. Compliance, do we need a signed candidate affidavit in addition to the marriage certificate? Also: fingerprinting requirement for this role is optional but vendor offers same-day digital FP for $40 — should we schedule?
Compliance-Luis: If the marriage certificate is certified and the candidate presents original documents in person, you can complete Form I-9. Please upload copies to the secure onboarding folder and log the reviewer name/date. Affidavit is optional in this case but recommended if the candidate only has scans. For audit trail: please email compliance@redwood.com with attachments.
Evan (Facilities): Logistics: we have a I-9 slot 9:00-10:30 tomorrow. I can escort and print visitor badge if HR confirms. Parking: I'll reserve one spot in Lot A; pls send plate.
Priya (IT): Devices: laptop imaged, temp account created (znewhire.temp@redwood.test). We hold full provisioning until I-9 complete. If background vendor allows fingerprinting, we can authenticate for elevated access after vendor clears.
Zoe (New Hire): I can be on-site 9:00. I prefer to avoid fingerprinting if possible, but if vendor needs it for background clearance I can do digital FP.
Nora (People Ops): Action plan: (1) Zoe bring originals — marriage certificate + current passport + state ID (2) Facilities: Evan to escort at 9:00 and print temp badge (3) Zoe to upload scans tonight and email compliance@redwood.com (4) Background vendor: if still blocked, schedule digital FP at 9:30 (opt-in) (5) IT to stage laptop and hold full access until clearance.
Background-Vendor: We can resume checks if certified marriage certificate is uploaded. If candidate consents, we can do same-day digital fingerprints at site. Consent link will be emailed when you confirm.
Priya (IT): Noted — provisioning window: we will give network + standard apps for day-1. Elevated access (prod/test infra) gated by vendor clear or manager sign-off. Temporary credentials will auto-expire in 72h if I-9/background incomplete.
Zoe (New Hire): Uploaded marriage cert and passport scan to the portal and emailed compliance. I consent to same-day digital FP if vendor requests.
Compliance-Luis: Received the email. Please ensure originals are presented in-person for the I-9. I like the reviewer (Nora) to cc compliance with scanned copies.
Nora (People Ops): Evan — can you confirm parking reservation and badge envelope? Also approve $35 for light breakfast? :croissant:
Evan (Facilities): Parking reserved (Lot A, spot 12). Badge envelopes prepped. I prefer pick-up for pastries 8:15 from BakerSt. Approved.
HR-Bot: Reminder: I-9 must be completed within 3 business days of start. Background vendor SLA is 48120 hours depending on fingerprinting. Keep candidate's onboarding calendar updated.
Nora (People Ops): Last note: Zoe will join benefits 11:00 remotely if any paperwork delays. If anything blocks, ping me directly. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
